reviews.text: Dr Arietta was incredibly smart, thoughtful, and thorough in her assessment of my cat. while we inevitably decided to put him down, she provided reasonably priced appropriate treatment options as well. I was allowed to sit in the exam room for over two hours weighing my decision. I never felt rushed, or pressured and was given all the information and all the options, and was allowed to speak with the doctor as many times as I needed to.  the entire team was so gentle and loving with pepito. i would absolutely return to franklin ave animal hospital if he were still around.

My cat Baldwin is 17 years old and nearing what is for us a dreaded stage of life. You can imagine our anxiety and sadness over the situation. The doctors, nurses, and staff at Franklin Avenue Animal Hospitals were so incredibly kind, generous, patient, and knowledgeable in their dealings with us during this tender time. Baldwin is not the friendliest cat on the planet (I imagine that there are panthers more friendly than Baldwin is) and everyone at Franklin Avenue Animal Hospital still handled him with the best attitudes with an eye toward his safety. One of the nurses joked that Baldwin had "fists rated E for Everyone." LOL! How could you not love a place that approaches their situations with that sort of levity and positivity? Absolutely Five-Star service.
Efficient staff abd very accessible

Franklin Ave Animal Hospital is an absolute delight! My dog goes there for physical therapy for orthopedic issues and it's one of the very few places where they offer water treadmill in the city. Dr. Isaacson is very warm, knowledgeable and listens intently to you and your questions. My dog has been through several surgeries within several different medical establishments, and this is the only one where he runs to the door. He is offered treats and sometimes toys, but he really only comes there for the love! The entire staff, front desk and techs, are incredibly friendly and seem to genuinely enjoy working with each other and supporting animal care. It's a pure treat for my dog to visit and he adores the staff. I highly recommend them and are thankful we found a place that provides this type of care and kindness.
I love this place everyone is so nice.I been bringing my dog Shelloni for awhile they care about your pet,I highly recommend.
Been going here for years. I'll always trusted this group of veterinarians. When I got a new puppy after 13 years and moved an hour away, I still came back!

I have found this practice to be professional, kind and compassionate for years with multiple pets. On a recent visit, my questions were answered, my cat was handled gently and I had a follow up call a week later. Crown Heights & Franklin Ave Animal Hospitals are wonderful to have as neighbors & I would recommend this practice highly.

New to the city and happy to report my dog and I have found an excellent vet at Franklin Ave Animal Hospital! I brought Roman in for his annual exam, some booster shots, and routine bloodwork, and all was handled wonderfully. Every staff member was knowledgeable, efficient, kind, and so gentle and sweet with my anxious rescue. In the past, with other vets, I have been upsold on a slew of treatments, products, etc, but here I got the impression that the care was completely transparent and reasonable. We will definitely be back!
Friendly service!

Our dog Kalina has been a patient here for over 3 years, with multiple visits a year due to a chronic issue. First we came for physical therapy (laser & started water treadmill), then extended to vet care. Dr Katz, Lorraine, and the team are so good with Kalina. We've seen some clinicians elsewhere open the door & visibly react to the sight of a nervous black mutt. But not this team. No matter how stinky the stuff I bring on her licki pad, how much meat we need to feed her, if I want her to have her blankie with her - they're game for whatever can help the patient. Of course we also discuss and try pharmacologic approaches as warranted, but creating a comfortable environment is well understood here. We recently moved neighborhoods and after some poor experiences with local vets, decided to go back to this team, even though it's quite far now. Transparent about prices and reasonable, compared to what we've been quoted elsewhere for both PT, exams etc. Thank you!

Went in there and had a terrible experience.  The woman at the front desk was extremely rude to me and my dog and had us waiting an ungodly amount of time, the vet on hand was extremely laxadasical and did as little as possible to help us, it seemed like they didn't even care. Definitely do not recommend going here if you need service for your furry loved one.
Dr. Arrieta is truly exceptional. She has provided great care to our dog, Kody, and helped us understand our options every step of the way.

My wife and I visited the crown heights animal hospital twice and both times we were given appointments here at this wonderful hospital. The last time on my birthday the crown heights site ignored my wife when she was speaking to the male receptionist. We are so grateful we were transferred here. The first time our cat Cubs was sick and the staff here was  amazing! We returned for his physical and once again amazing! Nurse Christine and Docto Arrieta was great and treated Cubs to some delicious churu .

I’ve been bringing my cats and dog here for a couple years now and I highly recommend! The staff is so kind and treat myself and my animals with the utmost respect and concern. As a quick example of how great they are - my pitbull has a strange affinity for churus (byproduct of living with cats). The staff has this noted on his sheet and give him a churu after every visit!

I have been a customer of Prospect/Crown Heights/Franklin Ave Animal Hospital for nearly 10 years, and overall I have had very few complaints. Doctors and staff are kind and helpful for the most part, they adapted well during the pandemic and have helped my pet through lots of different situations.

This said, they’ve recently introduced a 3% surcharge on credit card transactions, which seems odd given these are medical purchases. It feels like this only makes pet care more prohibitive to members of our community without the ability to pay upfront in cash, instead asking them to pay more for the same treatment. It doesn’t sit well.

Additionally, because I’ve had a credit card on file for so long, there have been two incidents in which they automatically charged it without offering a different payment option—once on a down payment after an appointment was made on the phone, and once in person. They kindly gave me a refund and let me put it on my debit card, but the entire thing rubbed me the wrong way.

Most recently (today) I tried to make a vaccination appointment for my dog and provided them with my debit card information for the $50 down payment fee. They let me know that they can’t take Debit cards over the phone, and therefore I’d either be forced to pay the credit processing fee or I’d have to come in person to make an appointment and pay with a debit card. Unfortunately the last straw, time to change vets. I had no idea a policy change like this would impact my view of this practice to such an extent, but here we are.

Vet bills can get extraordinarily expensive, passing on transaction fees to customers might be a good business decision, but it falls flat from a customer satisfaction perspective and folks should be prepared before arranging pet care at their locations.

Dr Katz is so friendly and great with my cat! The office is always very efficient and kind. This was also the most affordable place for my cat's teeth cleaning while giving me confidence that she is well taken care of.

This practice (and their Crown Heights sister location down the street) has been our go-to trusted vet for 8 years, 2 dogs, and 2 cats. All of the vets are great but we especially love an trust Dr. Kozak! She is so thoughtful and meticulous with our pets. I have always felt extremely cared for, listened to, and communicated with at this practice. I’m genuinely confused by reviews that say they felt pressured into expensive tests / treatments, because I have always felt like they give really helpful options about what tests to try first to stagger costs and eliminate bases one by one. I never had a vet that I particularly liked or trusted before, and I’m so grateful for them now!

Truly the best vet we’ve ever had. Dr. Katz was absolutely AMAZING! We cannot express enough how thankful we were to have him by our side during such a time of uncertainty. Our dog Neva had a disease that we were unable to find answers on after doing quite a few tests. She ended up on hospice care for several months. Dr. Katz went above and beyond for us, responding to my countless emails, thoroughly answering many questions, and trying different things to keep her comfy during her last months.
The staff is also great. When we had to drop off Neva for an all day test they called me to check in and let me know she was laying by them on a little bed relaxing and that she had even eaten some food. She’s an anxious dog so I was shocked to hear she was comfy and even eating!
Unfortunately we had to let her go, it was an extremely hard decision and they made the entire process peaceful. We miss her so much, she was everything to us. We are super grateful to have found such amazing care in the end.

We’ve been coming here for years—my wife even longer—and the experience has always been outstanding. The team provides top‑notch care not only for our pets but also for us as owners, making every visit reassuring and professional. Their compassion, expertise, and consistency set them apart. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a veterinary practice that truly goes above and beyond.

I spent many hours here over the past year treating my cat for FIP and have only great things to say about the team and the care they provided. Emotional support for pet owners isn't part of their job but I'll admit that a few tears were shed on my end across those early visits and everyone was reassuring, sensitive, and kind. Above and beyond doesn't even begin to describe their quality of care, from the follow-ups over email and phone to their assistance when I was looking for a cat sitter during the first week of FIP treatment. Each visit was bookended by friendly and warm treatment by the front desk staff and marked by great attention to detail from the vet techs (too many to name) and Dr. Arrieta, who went to great lengths to learn more about FIP (many vets have not yet treated it in cats due to recent developments in medication for a once nearly always fatal disease) and ensure my cat's health. I also appreciated working with Lorraine, who only saw my cat on his first visit (and was so reassuring after that very stressful diagnosis) but stopped in and said hello every time we were in. I am so grateful to every member of the staff that I interacted with and would highly recommend them to any pet owner whether it be for serious illness or the ocassional check-in. I'm cross posting this to the Prospect Heights location as my cat was seen at both.
Incredible staff. They are always so lovely with my pup whenever I take him.
rude and unhelpful staff, continually push overpriced products, and twice have tried to give my dog expensive procedures he doesn’t need.
The techs and vet were soooo kind.

My cats have have all received their care from this hospital (the Prospect/Crown Heights/Franklin locations) and in 16 years we've have only ever had positive experiences with them. Even after moving away from this neighborhood, we keep trekking out to these hospitals because we trust the people who work there. Vets, techs, and folks working at the front desk, they've all been kind and patient with us.
Really nice space and great service from all employees.

We brought our cat in to get some teeth removed and everyone, from the people at the front desk, to the tech, to Dr. Arrieta was so kind and caring and professional. Mimo recovered quickly and the staff made sure to answer all of our questions and check in over the next few days to make sure everything was going well!

I've taken my dog to this vet for over a year now and each time have had a wonderful experience. I've seen different vets, all super nice and helpful. The front desk is so friendly and my dog actually gets excited to go because she loves the people that much.

Can’t say enough about how comfortable I feel with my cat in their hands. They go above and beyond. I’ve heard vets are overburdened these days and at other places you can tell. At Franklin Ave Animal Hospital, they make time for you and your pet no matter what. It’s so clear how much they care.

Some of staff here are rude and condescending. My pup was having issues with diarrhea- he had a history of parasitic infections. I was requesting that the doctor give him a dewormer - I had recently spoken to a vet that recommended this route as it has little downside, treats for many different parasites, and is MUCH cheaper than having a full exam done - something that is extremely overpriced at this location. I can have fecal sampling done for $20-30 with a woman who runs a daycare nearby. I requested this multiple times, and every time they basically refused to give medication unless the doctor ran multiple tests and did an exam. This was also done in a way which was misleading - I was not rude at all, and was given false information a couple of times. If you aren’t rich, don’t bring your dog here.

UPDATE: The medication that the woman at the counter lied to me about saying I wouldn’t be able to get without a prescription is being delivered to my apartment tomorrow for $10 through Amazon. Don’t waste your money if you don’t have to. I understand it’s probably not mostly the desk workers faults, and is just their business model. BUT it is an extremely predatory one, and I find it to be despicable when it is in relation to the health of an innocent animal.
